title: Puzzle Bobble 3 for SegaNet
native_title: パズル・ボブル３ フォー セガネット
overview: This special release of Puzzle Bobble 3 is modified to exclusively support online multiplayer functionality via the Sega Saturn Modem and XBand service. Released at a lower price, most of the single-player content has been removed from this version, with only a short demo of the standard puzzle mode available for offline play.
